consumer: The engine's interactive pickup menu (NEW_PICKUP_MENU / inventory_selector) driven through the active input loop, asking 'which of the offered ground items does the player select to pick up?'
scope: The interactive pickup selection over the engine-offered, pickable ground items on the target tile(s), answered through the real input mechanism
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (items) -- it only serializes the raw map::i_at ground stack of nearby tiles into snapshot JSON; it never drives or represents the engine's pickup selection menu
divergence: A tile holds a non-pickable item (e.g. a liquid puddle on the ground with no container, or an item the pickup loop filters/merges) alongside pickable ones: the JSON lists it as a selectable entity, but the engine's real pickup menu never offers it, so a frontend 'choose to pick up' on that entry maps to a selection the engine loop refuses
